source.title: The House of Tata Meets the Second Industrial Revolution

passages.excerpt_preview: The book places the Tata enterprise within the Second Industrial Revolution and colonial India, where capital-intensive industry depended on institutions, expertise and relations with the state.
It argues that colonial industrial growth cannot be explained only by government policy or factor endowment; corporate-level institutional responses also mattered.
